name: 🦖Dinosaur Simulator🦕
desc:
💐Welcome to Dinosaur Simulator🦖!

😊This is a dinosaur growing game, I hope you like it👍, you are welcome to leave a message in the group! 💬
The second level can exchange crystals for turrets, and the third level has alien invaders.
👍Like for more rewards🎁.

💥Eat food to get gold coins and grow up💰,
💰Gold coins can buy new little dinosaurs🦕,

👍Please like us, we will develop more free content 🎁.

⭐This update⭐
🛠️Add several well-known dinosaurs, add new scenes, and optimize the game experience🐊.
